id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
it: Smart Rotom: chiamata in arrivo da Goh:

id: \bGoh: \PN, there's a new Project Mew mission. Could you meet me at the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort?
en: \bGoh: \PN, there's a new Project Mew mission.  Could you meet me at the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort?
it: \bGoh: \PN, c'è una nuova missione del Progetto Mew.  Puoi raggiungermi alle Rovine del Colosso nel Deserto della Quiete?

id: Stone Shop.\nFor all your stoning needs!
en: Stone Shop.\nFor all your stoning needs!
it: Negozio di Pietre.\nPer tutte le tue esigenze pietrose!

id: \bVolkner: Don't bother me...
en: \bVolkner: Don't bother me...
it: \bCorrado: Non disturbarmi...

id: \bVolkner: I'll meet you in the Gym.
en: \bVolkner: I'll meet you in the Gym.
it: \bCorrado: Ci vediamo in Palestra.

id: \rThe Sunnyshore Tower is similar to the one found in Johto, but not as big.
en: \rThe Sunnyshore Tower is similar to the one found in Johto, but not as big.
it: \rLa Torre di Arenipoli è simile a quella di Johto, ma non così grande.

id: \bMy bird can fly around. So what?
en: \bMy bird can fly around. So what?
it: \bIl mio uccello sa volare. E allora?

id: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
en: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
it: \bSuppongo che possiamo portarti in volo. Dove andiamo?

id: \bI'm about to leave and look for treasure.
en: \bI'm about to leave and look for treasure.
it: \bSto per partire a caccia di tesori.

id: \bWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.
en: \bWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.
it: \bChe Allenatore forte. Te lo meriti.

id: \bI'm a treasure hunter. One day I want to become an archaeology professor.
en: \bI'm a treasure hunter. One day I want to become an archaeology professor.
it: \bSono un cacciatore di tesori. Un giorno voglio diventare professore di archeologia.

id: \bThe city is too rocky. I prefer the flowers.
en: \bThe city is too rocky. I prefer the flowers.
it: \bLa città è troppo rocciosa. Preferisco i fiori.

id: \rDawn: \PN! Guess what? I competed in the Grand Festival and got runner-up. No need to worry, I'm happy with that.
en: \rDawn: \PN! Guess what? I competed in the Grand Festival and got runner-up. No need to worry, I'm happy with that.
it: \rLucinda: \PN! Indovina? Ho partecipato al Gran Festival e sono arrivata seconda. Non preoccuparti, ne sono contenta.

id: \rYou just got your last badge for the Sinnoh League? Congratulations \PN.
en: \rYou just got your last badge for the Sinnoh League?  Congratulations \PN.
it: \rHai appena ottenuto l'ultima Medaglia per la Lega di Sinnoh?  Congratulazioni, \PN.

id: \rNow that we're both acomplished Trainers, lets see which of us is stronger.
en: \rNow that we're both acomplished Trainers, lets see which of us is stronger.
it: \rOra che siamo entrambi Allenatori affermati, vediamo chi di noi è più forte.

id: \rNo matter how far I come you still show me I have a ways to go.
en: \rNo matter how far I come you still show me I have a ways to go.
it: \rPer quanta strada io faccia, mi dimostri sempre che ne ho ancora tanta da fare.

id: \rGood luck at the league!
en: \rGood luck at the league!
it: \rIn bocca al lupo per la Lega!

id: \rDawn: I'm planning on going to Johto. I'm going to compete in contests there.
en: \rDawn: I'm planning on going to Johto. I'm going to compete in contests there.
it: \rLucinda: Ho intenzione di andare a Johto. Parteciperò alle Gare laggiù.

id: \rSkar!
en: \rSkar!
it: \rSkar!

id: \rWe built the city out of rock. It's not easy living here.
en: \rWe built the city out of rock. It's not easy living here.
it: \rAbbiamo costruito la città sulla roccia. Non è facile vivere qui.

id: \bThe Gym Leader is somewhere in town right now.
en: \bThe Gym Leader is somewhere in town right now.
it: \bIl Capopalestra è da qualche parte in città in questo momento.

id: \bSadly, the gym was damaged when the Sunnyshore Tower was taken over. It will take some time to fix it.
en: \bSadly, the gym was damaged when the Sunnyshore Tower was taken over. It will take some time to fix it.
it: \bPurtroppo la Palestra è stata danneggiata quando la Torre di Arenipoli è stata occupata. Ci vorrà un po' di tempo per ripararla.

id: \bCamerupt...
en: \bCamerupt...
it: \bCamerupt...

id: Sunnyshore City\nSolar Powered!
en: Sunnyshore City\nSolar Powered!
it: Arenipoli\nAlimentata a energia solare!

id: Sunnyshore City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nVolkner
en: Sunnyshore City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nVolkner
it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Arenipoli:\nCorrado

id: The Shining, Shocking Star
en: The Shining, Shocking Star
it: La stella che brilla e folgora

id: \bThis bridge is famous. Not many places have such a complex bridge.
en: \bThis bridge is famous. Not many places have such a complex bridge.
it: \bQuesto ponte è famoso. Pochi posti hanno un ponte così complesso.

id: \bI'm leaving for the Sinnoh League soon.
en: \bI'm leaving for the Sinnoh League soon.
it: \bPresto partirò per la Lega di Sinnoh.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
it: \bBenvenuto. Dove vorresti andare?

id: \bThe Sinnoh League is over. Come back next year.
en: \bThe Sinnoh League is over. Come back next year.
it: \bLa Lega di Sinnoh è finita. Torna l'anno prossimo.

id: \bDewgong
en: \bDewgong
it: \bDewgong

id: Sunnyshore Tower
en: Sunnyshore Tower
it: Torre di Arenipoli

id: \bSo, you want to try again.
en: \bSo, you want to try again.
it: \bQuindi vuoi riprovarci.

id: \bWell done. Until next time.
en: \bWell done. Until next time.
it: \bBen fatto. Alla prossima.

id: \rI'm so embarassed. I lost my key.
en: \rI'm so embarassed. I lost my key.
it: \rChe imbarazzo. Ho perso la chiave.

id: \bFlint: You look like a strong Trainer. Are you here to battle Volkner?
en: \bFlint: You look like a strong Trainer. Are you here to battle Volkner?
it: \bVulcano: Sembri un Allenatore forte. Sei qui per lottare contro Corrado?

id: \bThe guy slipped into a funk. No one gives him a challenge anymore, and Volker is about ready to quit and fight the Elite Four.
en: \bThe guy slipped into a funk. No one gives him a challenge anymore, and Volker is about ready to quit and fight the Elite Four.
it: \bÈ finito in un periodo nero. Nessuno gli offre più una vera sfida, e Corrado è sul punto di mollare tutto e sfidare i Superquattro.

id: \bWhy not fight me? It may just inspire my friend to give it another go. By the way. I'm Flint, an Elite Four member.
en: \bWhy not fight me? It may just inspire my friend to give it another go. By the way. I'm Flint, an Elite Four member.
it: \bPerché non lotti contro di me? Potrebbe spingere il mio amico a riprovarci. A proposito, sono Vulcano, un membro dei Superquattro.

id: \bSo what do you say? Want to battle?
en: \bSo what do you say? Want to battle?
it: \bAllora, che ne dici? Vuoi lottare?

id: \bThat's fine. Come back when you're ready.
en: \bThat's fine. Come back when you're ready.
it: \bNessun problema. Torna quando sarai pronto.

id: \bFlint: That was a great battle! What do you think, Volkner? Give the kid a try.
en: \bFlint: That was a great battle! What do you think, Volkner? Give the kid a try.
it: \bVulcano: Che lotta fantastica! Che ne pensi, Corrado? Dai una possibilità al ragazzo.

id: \bVolkner: I suppose I will. Meet me in the Gym.
en: \bVolkner: I suppose I will. Meet me in the Gym.
it: \bCorrado: Credo che lo farò. Ci vediamo in Palestra.

id: \bFlint: This is great. Be sure to give Volkner a tough battle.
en: \bFlint: This is great. Be sure to give Volkner a tough battle.
it: \bVulcano: Fantastico. Mi raccomando, dai a Corrado del filo da torcere.

id: \rSmeargle
en: \rSmeargle
it: \rSmeargle

id: \bVolkner has lost his motivation. I've known him since he was a kid. It's frustrating to watch him like this.
en: \bVolkner has lost his motivation. I've known him since he was a kid. It's frustrating to watch him like this.
it: \bCorrado ha perso la motivazione. Lo conosco da quando era bambino. È frustrante vederlo così.

id: \bVolkner is full of energy these days. It warms my heart to see him full of spirit again.
en: \bVolkner is full of energy these days. It warms my heart to see him full of spirit again.
it: \bIn questi giorni Corrado è pieno di energia. Mi scalda il cuore vederlo di nuovo così grintoso.

id: \bVolker often gets bored. He occasionally causes power blackouts from his gym experiments.
en: \bVolker often gets bored. He occasionally causes power blackouts from his gym experiments.
it: \bCorrado si annoia spesso. Ogni tanto causa dei blackout con i suoi esperimenti in Palestra.

id: \bHow did you get here?
en: \bHow did you get here?
it: \bCome sei arrivato qui?
